A '''module harness''' was a device for sale at [[Kitak Hu]]'s weapons shop on [[Vorzyd V/Legends|Vorzyd V]]. It attached to an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] and allowed the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to be fitted with weapons.
